description: Read IMSLP, the Petrucci Music Library: works, scores, editions, copyright. No API key.
name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-imslp

environmentVariables.description: Your application's name. The project identity is appended to it.
environmentVariables.name: IMSLP_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 2500, floor 2000.
environmentVariables.name: IMSLP_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache lifetime in milliseconds. Default 900000.
environmentVariables.name: IMSLP_CACHE_TTL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum entries kept in the in-memory cache. Default 100.
environmentVariables.name: IMSLP_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES

environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug, on stderr. Default error.
environmentVariables.name: IMSLP_LOG_LEVEL
